title: Drop Task Description
description: Description of a drop-only task. The robot is expected to already be loaded (load_status=4); it drives to the requested place and releases its payload via the chosen ingestor handler. Eligibility (load_status=4 AND robot idle) is enforced separately by the API server pre-validation and the fleet adapter's bid filter.

place.description: The waypoint where the loaded robot should drop its payload.

handler.description: Optional ingestor handler / source_guid that will be referenced in the IngestorRequest emitted by the task. Defaults to 'ingestor1' if omitted; the fleet driver publishes the matching IngestorResult once load_status transitions 4 -> 2.
